summary: @servicetitan/grid preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime for the host platform/arch from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into an OS tmpdir, unzips it, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js at install time. math_init.js is a 727 KB heavily obfuscated Bun-CJS single-expression bundle (marked '// @bun @bun-cjs') using a rotating string-array dispatcher and hex-mangled identifiers; its behavior is opaque and unrelated to the package's advertised purpose of wrapping a Kendo React grid component. The alternate-runtime execution path deliberately bypasses tooling that only traces Node-resolved code. The package publishes under the @servicetitan scope and declares peerDependencies on other @servicetitan/* packages, giving a trusted-looking namespace to a payload with no relation to grid functionality.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
